author: Stimulating
body:
One thing I've noticed on Avicus, is that there's a lack of diverse gameplay. We only have DTM maps and IMO there should be DTC, and CTW I know is going to be implemented. The issue is that there's a lack of diverse gameplay, never any defences set up and you either play maps just going balls to the wall for the objective or getting kills. There isn't enough different styles of gameplay in the maps. I personally would like to see some tourney-style maps implemented into rots for normal gameplay. Two styles of maps that I feel aren't implemented well, are the ones that are about skybridge control and cannoning. I'm not talking tower up 128 blocks in the air and bridge to the monument from across the map, I'm talking about people running up to staircase  and making large skybridges with PvP room and trying to get/keep control over them. 

I would like to see these types of maps implemented in rotations, thoughts? Ideas?

replies.author: Stimulating
replies.body:
well none of our players or fanbase have any experience with any cannons whatsoever and imo it'd be great to implement TNT cannons into Avi correctly. 

@Porky I'm more focusing on the DTM, CTW, and DTC style modes. Yes we'll have SG, but I'm more looking at modes where you can break/manipulate blocks. Plus it's not just minigames, just the lack of different playstyles with the maps is what I don't like. Yes, you play every map different, but there aren't diverse playstyles associated with maps on Avicus.
